functions.name: SteamIPAddress_t::IsSet
functions.description: Checks whether the SteamIPAddress_t instance represents a non-zero address. For IPv4, returns true if m_unIPv4 != 0 (host byte order). For IPv6, returns true if either 64-bit word in m_ipv6Qword is non-zero (stored big-endian; m_rgubIPv6 is network byte order). Typical usage: call on an already-initialized SteamIPAddress_t to verify it has been set to an address other than 0.0.0.0 or ::.
requirements: The SteamIPAddress_t object must be a valid, initialized instance before calling.
m_eType should correspond to k_ESteamIPTypeIPv4 or k_ESteamIPTypeIPv6 for meaningful results; otherwise the else-branch treats it as IPv6.
Callers should interpret IPv4 in host byte order and IPv6 in network byte order as documented in the struct comments.

functions.name: SteamIPAddress_t::IPv4Any
functions.description: Factory method that returns an IPv4 "any" address (0.0.0.0). Sets m_eType to k_ESteamIPTypeIPv4 and m_unIPv4 to 0 (host byte order). Useful for binding/listening on any local interface.
requirements: No input requirements; returns a fully-initialized SteamIPAddress_t for IPv4 any (0.0.0.0).
Callers should treat the returned IPv4 value as host byte order.

functions.name: SteamIPAddress_t::IPv6Any
functions.description: Factory method that returns an IPv6 "any" address (::). Sets m_eType to k_ESteamIPTypeIPv6 and zeroes both 64-bit words. m_rgubIPv6 is in network byte order. Useful for binding/listening on any local interface for IPv6.
requirements: No input requirements; returns a fully-initialized SteamIPAddress_t for IPv6 any (::).
Callers should interpret the IPv6 bytes as network byte order (big-endian).

functions.name: SteamIPAddress_t::IPv4Loopback
functions.description: Factory method that returns the IPv4 loopback address (127.0.0.1). Sets m_eType to k_ESteamIPTypeIPv4 and m_unIPv4 to 0x7f000001 (host byte order). Use when you need a local-only IPv4 address.
requirements: No input requirements; returns a fully-initialized SteamIPAddress_t for IPv4 loopback (127.0.0.1).
Callers should treat the returned IPv4 value as host byte order.

functions.name: SteamIPAddress_t::IPv6Loopback
functions.description: Factory method that returns the IPv6 loopback address (::1). Sets m_eType to k_ESteamIPTypeIPv6, zeroes both 64-bit words, then sets the last byte of m_rgubIPv6 to 1 (network byte order). Use when you need a local-only IPv6 address.
requirements: No input requirements; returns a fully-initialized SteamIPAddress_t for IPv6 loopback (::1).

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::CreateListenSocketIP
functions.signature: virtual HSteamListenSocket CreateListenSocketIP( const SteamNetworkingIPAddr &localAddress, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t *pOptions ) = 0;
functions.description: Create a server listen socket bound to a specific local IPv4/IPv6 address/port for clients that connect via ConnectByIPAddress over UDP. Use SteamNetworkingIPAddr::Clear() for wildcard IP and set port. Initial config can be supplied via pOptions.
requirements: localAddress must have a valid port set; typically IP is wildcard (Cleared) or a specific interface IP
nOptions may be 0 or the count of entries in pOptions
pOptions may be NULL or point to nOptions config values; see SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t
On connection attempts, handle SteamNetConnectionStatusChangedCallback_t and call AcceptConnection or CloseConnection promptly

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::ConnectByIPAddress
functions.signature: virtual HSteamNetConnection ConnectByIPAddress( const SteamNetworkingIPAddr &address, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t *pOptions ) = 0;

requirements: address must specify a valid remote IP and port that matches a server listening with CreateListenSocketIP
nOptions may be 0 or the number of pOptions entries
pOptions may be NULL or valid pointer to nOptions config values
Application should handle SteamNetConnectionStatusChangedCallback_t and decide on authentication/identity acceptance

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::CreateListenSocketP2P
functions.signature: virtual HSteamListenSocket CreateListenSocketP2P( int nLocalVirtualPort, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t *pOptions ) = 0;
functions.description: Create a listen socket for relayed P2P connections. Clients connect using ConnectP2P to this virtual port. Useful for single or multiple logical endpoints.
requirements: nLocalVirtualPort is an app-defined small nonnegative integer (commonly 0, recommended <1000) unique per listen socket
Call ISteamNetworkingUtils::InitRelayNetworkAccess() during app init for P2P/relay readiness
nOptions/pOptions semantics as other create functions; pOptions may be NULL
If using for hosted dedicated servers without tickets, ensure server environment is set appropriately

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::ConnectP2P

functions.description: Begin connecting to a peer identified by a platform-specific SteamNetworkingIdentity over the default signaling/rendezvous service (e.g., Steam backend). Connects to the specified remote virtual port.
requirements: identityRemote must identify the target peer as used by your platform/backend
nRemoteVirtualPort must match a listen socket created with CreateListenSocketP2P on the remote
nOptions is count of pOptions; pOptions may be NULL
For alternative signaling, use ConnectP2PCustomSignaling or config callback

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::AcceptConnection
functions.description: Accept an incoming connection that is in Connecting state after your listen socket received a request. Transitions to Connected or FindingRoute as appropriate.
requirements: hConn must be a valid incoming connection in k_ESteamNetworkingConnectionState_Connecting
Call promptly (within a second or two) after receiving SteamNetConnectionStatusChangedCallback_t to avoid client timeouts
May set per-connection config before calling AcceptConnection
Handle possible return codes: k_EResultInvalidParam, k_EResultInvalidState

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::CloseConnection
functions.signature: virtual bool CloseConnection( HSteamNetConnection hPeer, int nReason, const char *pszDebug, bool bEnableLinger ) = 0;
functions.description: Close an existing connection. Optionally provide an application-defined reason code and debug string. Optionally enable linger to flush remaining reliable data.
requirements: hPeer must be a valid connection handle (or previously ended to just free local interface)
nReason should be from ESteamNetConnectionEnd restricted range; 0 allowed to map to k_ESteamNetConnectionEnd_App_Generic
pszDebug may be NULL or a human-readable string
If bEnableLinger is true, reliable data may be flushed before teardown; otherwise queued reliable data is discarded
Unread data on connection is discarded on close

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::CloseListenSocket
functions.description: Destroy a listen socket. All connections accepted on it are closed ungracefully.
requirements: hSocket must be a valid listen socket handle
Caller should expect all dependent connections to be closed immediately and handle their callbacks/cleanup

functions.description: Associate application-defined 64-bit user data with a connection. Appears in various APIs and messages.
requirements: hPeer must be a valid connection handle
Beware of callback timing: callbacks carry the value that was current when queued; messages fetched via ReceiveMessagesOnConnection carry the latest user data
For atomic set at creation, see k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_ConnectionUserData

functions.signature: virtual EResult SendMessageToConnection( HSteamNetConnection hConn, const void *pData, uint32 cbData, int nSendFlags, int64 *pOutMessageNumber ) = 0;
functions.description: Send a single message on a connection with specified send flags (e.g., reliable/unreliable, no-delay). Returns a result or assigns a message number on success.
requirements: hConn must be a valid, connected (or connecting) connection handle; otherwise expect k_EResultInvalidState or k_EResultNoConnection
pData must point to a valid buffer of size cbData
cbData must be <= k_cbMaxSteamNetworkingSocketsMessageSizeSend or k_EResultInvalidParam is returned

Overall send queue limits may cause k_EResultLimitExceeded (see k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_SendBufferSize)

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::SendMessages
functions.signature: virtual void SendMessages( int nMessages, SteamNetworkingMessage_t *const *pMessages, int64 *pOutMessageNumberOrResult ) = 0;
functions.description: Send one or more pre-allocated message objects without copying payloads. Most efficient way to send messages. Ownership of message objects transfers to the library.
requirements: nMessages must be >= 0; pMessages must point to an array of nMessages pointers
Each SteamNetworkingMessage_t must be allocated via ISteamNetworkingUtils::AllocateMessage (do not stack-allocate)
Each message must have m_conn set to a valid connection handle and m_nFlags set (k_nSteamNetworkingSend_* flags)

If supplying your own payload buffer, it must remain valid until the message's free callback is invoked; callback must be fast and thread-safe; it may be called from any thread and even before SendMessages returns
Do not read or modify messages after passing to this call; the library takes ownership
pOutMessageNumberOrResult may be NULL or an array of length nMessages to receive message numbers or negative EResult codes per message

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::FlushMessagesOnConnection
functions.description: Flush messages waiting on the Nagle timer and send at the next opportunity. Useful when Nagle is enabled to force immediate send.
requirements: hConn must be a valid connection handle
Returns k_EResultIgnored if not yet connected; other errors include k_EResultInvalidParam, k_EResultInvalidState, k_EResultNoConnection

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::ReceiveMessagesOnConnection
functions.signature: virtual int ReceiveMessagesOnConnection( HSteamNetConnection hConn, SteamNetworkingMessage_t **ppOutMessages, int nMaxMessages ) = 0;
functions.description: Fetch up to nMaxMessages pending messages from a specific connection. Returns count or -1 if handle invalid. Messages must be released by the caller.
requirements: hConn must be a valid connection handle; -1 is returned if invalid
ppOutMessages must be non-NULL and point to an array with capacity for nMaxMessages pointers
nMaxMessages must be > 0 to receive anything
Caller MUST call SteamNetworkingMessage_t::Release() on each returned message when finished; safe to defer and release from any thread
Reliable messages preserve order; unreliable may be dropped, duplicated, or arrive out of order

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::CreateSocketPair
functions.signature: virtual bool CreateSocketPair( HSteamNetConnection *pOutConnection1, HSteamNetConnection *pOutConnection2, bool bUseNetworkLoopback, const SteamNetworkingIdentity *pIdentity1, const SteamNetworkingIdentity *pIdentity2 ) = 0;
functions.description: Create a pair of locally connected connections (loopback). Useful for testing or local server/client unified code. Can use in-memory fast path or real network loopback with optional fake lag/loss and encryption overhead.
requirements: pOutConnection1 and pOutConnection2 must be valid pointers to receive connection handles; both sides must be closed to fully release resources

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSockets::ConfigureConnectionLanes

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::SendMessageToUser
functions.signature: virtual EResult SendMessageToUser( const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identityRemote, const void *pubData, uint32 cubData, int nSendFlags, int nRemoteChannel ) = 0;
functions.description: Send a message to the specified remote identity. If no session exists, one is implicitly created (handshake may occur). On handshake failure, a SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionFailed_t callback is posted; success has no callback (use an application-level reply/ack). Reliable messages on the same channel to the same host are delivered exactly once and in order; no other ordering guarantees exist. Intended as a UDP-like, connectionless send on top of SteamNetworkingSockets. Use channels to logically route traffic; receiver must call ReceiveMessagesOnChannel on the same channel to get the data.
requirements: identityRemote must identify the intended remote peer; an implicit session will be created if one does not exist.
pubData must point to at least cubData bytes if cubData > 0.
cubData is the size in bytes of the payload; may be 0 for empty payloads.
nSendFlags is a bitmask of k_nSteamNetworkingSend_xxx options; using k_nSteamNetworkingSend_AutoRestartBrokenSession allows automatic session restart on a broken session.
nRemoteChannel is an integer channel/routing number; use 0 if channelization is not needed. Small integers are most efficient.
Reliable delivery is only ordered and exactly-once per (remote host, channel). Unreliable messages may be dropped, reordered, or duplicated.
On k_EResultNoConnection, caller must either call CloseSessionWithUser to acknowledge and then retry, or retry with k_nSteamNetworkingSend_AutoRestartBrokenSession.
For detailed failure info after errors/timeouts, caller may query GetSessionConnectionInfo soon after the failure (information may time out).
Return handling: check EResult. k_EREsultOK indicates the message was accepted for send; other codes may be returned as documented for ISteamNetworkingSockets::SendMessageToConnection.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::ReceiveMessagesOnChannel
functions.signature: virtual int ReceiveMessagesOnChannel( int nLocalChannel, SteamNetworkingMessage_t **ppOutMessages, int nMaxMessages ) = 0;
functions.description: Retrieve up to nMaxMessages incoming messages on the specified local channel that were sent via SendMessageToUser. Returns the number of messages returned (0 if none). The caller takes ownership of returned SteamNetworkingMessage_t objects and must release them.
requirements: nLocalChannel specifies which channel’s queue to read.
ppOutMessages must point to writable storage for an array of SteamNetworkingMessage_t* with capacity at least nMaxMessages.
nMaxMessages must be >= 1 to receive anything; the function will return at most this many messages.
The caller must call SteamNetworkingMessage_t::Release() on each returned message object when finished to avoid leaks.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::AcceptSessionWithUser
functions.description: Explicitly accept a pending session request from a remote user, typically in response to a SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t callback. If a session is already active with the user, returns true as well. Calling SendMessageToUser implicitly accepts any pending session with that user.
requirements: Should be called in response to a SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t when you intend to communicate with that user.
identityRemote must match the user whose session request you intend to accept.
Returns false if there is no pending (or any) session with that user; true if a session exists or is accepted.
If you prefer implicit acceptance, calling SendMessageToUser also accepts pending requests.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::CloseSessionWithUser
functions.description: Close the session with the specified user to immediately free underlying resources. Future messages from that user will trigger new SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t callbacks. Idle sessions are also automatically timed out after a period.
requirements: Call when you are done communicating with the specified user to proactively release resources.
identityRemote must specify the session to be closed.
After closing, new data from the user will cause a new SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t callback.
Note: Sessions that go unused for a few minutes time out automatically (no callback on timeout).

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::CloseChannelWithUser
functions.signature: virtual bool CloseChannelWithUser( const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identityRemote, int nLocalChannel ) = 0;
functions.description: Close communication with the specified user on a single local channel. Once all channels to a user are closed, the overall session is closed. New data from the user after all channels are closed will trigger a SteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest_t callback.
requirements: identityRemote must specify the remote user whose channel is to be closed.
nLocalChannel indicates which local channel to close for that user.
Closing all open channels to a user results in the session being closed.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingMessages::GetSessionConnectionInfo
functions.signature: virtual ESteamNetworkingConnectionState GetSessionConnectionInfo( const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identityRemote, SteamNetConnectionInfo_t *pConnectionInfo, SteamNetConnectionRealTimeStatus_t *pQuickStatus ) = 0;
functions.description: Query the latest known connection state for the session with the given peer. Primarily for debugging or to obtain detailed failure information after SendMessageToUser issues. Returns the SteamNetConnectionInfo_t::m_eState or k_ESteamNetworkingConnectionState_None if no connection exists. You may pass nullptr for either details pointer. Note that sessions time out; you cannot wait indefinitely to query failure reasons.
requirements: identityRemote identifies the peer whose session/connection info is requested.
pConnectionInfo may be nullptr if detailed connection info is not needed; otherwise points to writable storage.
pQuickStatus may be nullptr if real-time status is not needed; otherwise points to writable storage.
Return value is a ESteamNetworkingConnectionState indicating current/last-known state or None if no connection exists.
Failure details may become unavailable after a timeout; query promptly after errors.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::AllocateMessage

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::InitRelayNetworkAccess

Internally triggers a long-lived ping data refresh (CheckPingDataUpToDate with a very large max age). Intended to be called at program launch if relay use is anticipated.
requirements: May be called even if not strictly necessary; avoids first-use delay.
Dedicated servers in known DCs do not need to call this unless using P2P features.
Completion can be detected via GetRelayNetworkStatus or SteamRelayNetworkStatus_t callback.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetRelayNetworkStatus

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::EstimatePingTimeBetweenTwoLocations
functions.signature: virtual int ISteamNetworkingUtils::EstimatePingTimeBetweenTwoLocations( const SteamNetworkPingLocation_t &location1, const SteamNetworkPingLocation_t &location2 ) = 0;
functions.description: Estimates round-trip latency (ms) between two ping locations based on optimal routing through the Valve relay network. Provides a conservative estimate without sending packets. Returns a negative value on failure (e.g., k_nSteamNetworkingPing_Failed or k_nSteamNetworkingPing_Unknown).
requirements: location1 and location2 must be valid ping locations (obtained via GetLocalPingLocation or parsing a previously generated string).
Caller must handle negative return values indicating failure or unknown.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::EstimatePingTimeFromLocalHost
functions.description: Optimized latency estimate (ms) from local host to a remote ping location, using additional local information about routing. May differ slightly from combining GetLocalPingLocation with EstimatePingTimeBetweenTwoLocations.
requirements: remoteLocation must be a valid ping location marker.
Caller must handle negative return values indicating failure or unknown.

requirements: popID must be a valid SteamNetworkingPOPID.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetPOPCount

functions.signature: virtual int ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetPOPList( SteamNetworkingPOPID *list, int nListSz ) = 0;

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetDebugOutputFunction
functions.signature: virtual void ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetDebugOutputFunction( ESteamNetworkingSocketsDebugOutputType eDetailLevel, FSteamNetworkingSocketsDebugOutput pfnFunc ) = 0;
functions.description: Registers a callback to receive networking debug/log output at or above the specified detail level. Useful for development and troubleshooting; avoid high detail in production for performance.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::IsFakeIPv4
functions.description: Returns true if the given IPv4 address is recognized as a Steam FakeIP range, based on logical tests only. Internally delegates to GetIPv4FakeIPType and checks for type > k_ESteamNetworkingFakeIPType_NotFake.
requirements: nIPv4 is a 32-bit IPv4 address in host byte order as used by the API.
No network lookup is performed; purely deterministic check.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetIPv4FakeIPType
functions.description: Classifies an IPv4 address as FakeIP or not and returns its specific FakeIP type.
requirements: nIPv4 is a 32-bit IPv4 address in host byte order as used by the API.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetRealIdentityForFakeIP
functions.description: Resolves a FakeIP to the real SteamNetworkingIdentity when known. Returns k_EResultInvalidParam if the IP is not a FakeIP, or k_EResultNoMatch if it is unknown/expired.
requirements: fakeIP must contain a valid FakeIP address; otherwise expect k_EResultInvalidParam.
pOutRealIdentity must be non-NULL and writable to receive the resolved identity.
Resolution is guaranteed for active connections and local assigned FakeIPs; recently-destroyed connections may still resolve for a short time.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalConfigValueInt32
functions.description: Convenience wrapper to set a global integer configuration value (calls SetConfigValue with k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_Global and k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_Int32).
requirements: eValue must refer to a config that accepts Int32 type exactly.
Applies at global scope; affects default for all objects unless overridden.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalConfigValueFloat
functions.description: Convenience wrapper to set a global floating-point configuration value.
requirements: eValue must accept Float type exactly.
Applies at global scope; affects default for all objects unless overridden.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalConfigValueString
functions.description: Convenience wrapper to set a global string configuration value.
requirements: eValue must accept String type exactly.
val must be a valid NUL-terminated string for the lifetime of the call.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalConfigValuePtr
functions.description: Convenience wrapper to set a global pointer-type configuration value. Internally passes a pointer to the pointer as required by SetConfigValue.
requirements: eValue must accept Ptr type exactly.
When setting pointers (e.g., callbacks), you must pass a pointer to the function pointer via this wrapper; do not cast and pass the function pointer directly to SetConfigValue.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueInt32
functions.signature: bool ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueInt32( HSteamNetConnection hConn, ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, int32 val );
functions.description: Sets a per-connection integer configuration value for the specified connection handle.
requirements: hConn must be a valid HSteamNetConnection.
eValue must accept Int32 type exactly.
Only applies to the specified connection scope.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueFloat
functions.signature: bool ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueFloat( HSteamNetConnection hConn, ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, float val );
functions.description: Sets a per-connection floating-point configuration value for the specified connection handle.
requirements: hConn must be a valid HSteamNetConnection.
eValue must accept Float type exactly.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueString
functions.signature: bool ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConnectionConfigValueString( HSteamNetConnection hConn, ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, const char *val );
functions.description: Sets a per-connection string configuration value for the specified connection handle.
requirements: hConn must be a valid HSteamNetConnection.
eValue must accept String type exactly.
val must be a valid NUL-terminated string for the lifetime of the call.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_SteamNetConnectionStatusChanged
functions.description: Registers a global callback for SteamNetConnectionStatusChanged events using the global config mechanism.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamNetConnectionStatusChanged.
The callback is installed globally and may be invoked from internal threads.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_SteamNetAuthenticationStatusChanged
functions.description: Registers a global callback for Steam networking authentication status changes.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamNetAuthenticationStatusChanged.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_SteamRelayNetworkStatusChanged
functions.description: Registers a global callback for Steam relay network status changes.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamRelayNetworkStatusChanged.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_FakeIPResult
functions.description: Registers a global callback for FakeIP result events.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamNetworkingFakeIPResult.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_MessagesSessionRequest
functions.description: Registers a global callback for messages session requests.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamNetworkingMessagesSessionRequest.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetGlobalCallback_MessagesSessionFailed
functions.description: Registers a global callback for messages session failures.
requirements: fnCallback must be a valid function pointer compatible with FnSteamNetworkingMessagesSessionFailed.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConfigValue
functions.signature: virtual bool ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConfigValue( ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, ESteamNetworkingConfigScope eScopeType, intptr_t scopeObj, ESteamNetworkingConfigDataType eDataType, const void *pArg ) = 0;
functions.description: Sets a configuration value on a specified scope (global, connection, listen socket, interface, etc.). The data at pArg must exactly match the declared type eDataType for the chosen eValue. Passing NULL removes a non-global override or resets global to defaults. For pointer settings, pass a pointer to the pointer.
requirements: eDataType must exactly match the target config variable’s type.
scopeObj must be the appropriate object identifier for the given scope (e.g., connection handle) and is ignored for global scope.
pArg may be NULL to clear non-global overrides or reset global to defaults.
When setting pointer values, pArg must point to the pointer (e.g., a function pointer variable), not the pointer value cast.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConfigValueStruct
functions.signature: bool ISteamNetworkingUtils::SetConfigValueStruct( const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t &opt, ESteamNetworkingConfigScope eScopeType, intptr_t scopeObj );
functions.description: Convenience helper to set a config value using a SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t. Handles string and pointer semantics and delegates to SetConfigValue.
requirements: opt must be properly populated: m_eValue, m_eDataType, and m_val fields consistent.
For string type, the string buffer in opt.m_val.m_string is used as pArg; for pointer types, a pointer to the pointer is passed internally.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetConfigValue
functions.signature: virtual ESteamNetworkingGetConfigValueResult ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetConfigValue( ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, ESteamNetworkingConfigScope eScopeType, intptr_t scopeObj, ESteamNetworkingConfigDataType *pOutDataType, void *pResult, size_t *cbResult ) = 0;
functions.description: Retrieves a configuration value at the specified scope, optionally returning its data type and copying the value into a caller buffer. Supports a size-query pattern: pass pResult=NULL to have cbResult set to required size and receive k_ESteamNetworkingGetConfigValue_BufferTooSmall.
requirements: pOutDataType may be NULL; if non-NULL it receives the value’s data type.
pResult may be NULL to query required size; otherwise must point to a buffer of cbResult bytes.
cbResult must be non-NULL; on input contains buffer size, on output receives bytes written or required.
Caller must handle the returned ESteamNetworkingGetConfigValueResult, including BufferTooSmall for sizing.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetConfigValueInfo
functions.signature: virtual const char *ISteamNetworkingUtils::GetConfigValueInfo( ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eValue, ESteamNetworkingConfigDataType *pOutDataType, ESteamNetworkingConfigScope *pOutScope ) = 0;
functions.description: Returns information about a configuration value, including its name (const char*), data type, and scope. Returns NULL if the value does not exist.
requirements: pOutDataType and pOutScope are optional and may be NULL; if non-NULL, they receive the data type and default scope.
Caller must handle NULL return if eValue is invalid.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::IterateGenericEditableConfigValues
functions.signature: virtual ESteamNetworkingConfigValue ISteamNetworkingUtils::IterateGenericEditableConfigValues( ESteamNetworkingConfigValue eCurrent, bool bEnumerateDevVars ) = 0;
functions.description: Iterates over configuration values suitable for generic UI display/editing. Pass k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_Invalid to get the first; iteration ends when k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_Invalid is returned. Optionally include developer-only vars.
requirements: eCurrent must be k_ESteamNetworkingConfig_Invalid to start, or the last returned value to continue.
Set bEnumerateDevVars=true to include developer-only variables; false to exclude.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ToString
functions.signature: virtual void ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ToString( const SteamNetworkingIPAddr &addr, char *buf, size_t cbBuf, bool bWithPort ) = 0;
functions.description: Converts a SteamNetworkingIPAddr to a human-readable string, optionally including the port. Writes into caller-provided buffer.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and writable.
cbBuf must specify the size of buf in bytes and be large enough to hold the result plus NUL.
addr must contain a valid address.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ParseString
functions.description: Parses a textual IP (and optionally port) into a SteamNetworkingIPAddr. Returns true on success.
requirements: pAddr must be non-NULL and writable.
pszStr must be a valid NUL-terminated string containing an address (format per library conventions).
Caller must handle false for parse failures.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIPAddr_GetFakeIPType
functions.description: Determines whether the given address is a FakeIP and returns its FakeIP type.
requirements: addr must be a valid SteamNetworkingIPAddr.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIdentity_ToString
functions.signature: virtual void ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIdentity_ToString( const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identity, char *buf, size_t cbBuf ) = 0;
functions.description: Converts a SteamNetworkingIdentity to a textual form and writes it to the caller’s buffer.
requirements: buf must be non-NULL and writable.
cbBuf must be the size of the buffer in bytes and large enough for the output and NUL.
identity must be valid.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingUtils::SteamNetworkingIdentity_ParseString
functions.description: Parses a textual identity into a SteamNetworkingIdentity. Returns true on success.
requirements: pIdentity must be non-NULL and writable.
pszStr must be a valid NUL-terminated string in a supported identity format.
Caller must handle false for parse failures.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingUtils_LibV4
functions.description: Standalone library accessor that returns the SteamNetworkingUtils interface pointer for version SteamNetworkingUtils004. Available when STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STANDALONELIB is defined.
requirements: Only available in builds defining STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STANDALONELIB.
Caller should not assume thread-safety beyond what the interface guarantees.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingUtils_Lib
functions.description: Inline helper that returns SteamNetworkingUtils_LibV4() in standalone builds. Convenience alias for obtaining ISteamNetworkingUtils.
requirements: Only available when STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STANDALONELIB is defined.
Returns the same pointer as SteamNetworkingUtils_LibV4().

functions.name: SteamNetworkingUtils
functions.description: Global accessor for ISteamNetworkingUtils. In standalone builds (without STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STEAMAPI) returns SteamNetworkingUtils_LibV4(); in Steamworks SDK builds returns SteamNetworkingUtils_SteamAPI().
requirements: Availability and exact implementation depend on build defines (STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STANDALONELIB / STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_STEAMAPI).
Caller must ensure Steamworks/standalone initialization as required by the build environment.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ToString
functions.signature: STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_INTERFACE void SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ToString( const SteamNetworkingIPAddr *pAddr, char *buf, size_t cbBuf, bool bWithPort );
functions.description: Standalone C-style helper that converts a SteamNetworkingIPAddr to string, writing into the caller’s buffer. Equivalent to the interface method in static/standalone builds.
requirements: pAddr must be non-NULL and point to a valid address.
buf must be non-NULL and writable.
cbBuf must specify buffer size in bytes and be large enough for the result including NUL.
bWithPort toggles inclusion of the port.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ParseString
functions.signature: STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_INTERFACE bool SteamNetworkingIPAddr_ParseString( SteamNetworkingIPAddr *pAddr, const char *pszStr );
functions.description: Parses a textual IP (and optional port) into a SteamNetworkingIPAddr. Returns true on success. Standalone/static helper.
requirements: pAddr must be non-NULL and writable.
pszStr must be a valid NUL-terminated string.
Caller must handle false for parse failures.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingIPAddr_GetFakeIPType
functions.description: Determines the FakeIP classification of an address. Standalone/static helper equivalent to the interface method.
requirements: pAddr must be non-NULL and point to a valid SteamNetworkingIPAddr.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingIdentity_ToString
functions.signature: STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_INTERFACE void SteamNetworkingIdentity_ToString( const SteamNetworkingIdentity *pIdentity, char *buf, size_t cbBuf );
functions.description: Converts a SteamNetworkingIdentity to text, writing into the caller’s buffer. Standalone/static helper.
requirements: pIdentity must be non-NULL and valid.
buf must be non-NULL and writable; cbBuf must specify buffer size in bytes and be sufficient for output and NUL.

functions.name: SteamNetworkingIdentity_ParseString
functions.signature: STEAMNETWORKINGSOCKETS_INTERFACE bool SteamNetworkingIdentity_ParseString( SteamNetworkingIdentity *pIdentity, size_t sizeofIdentity, const char *pszStr );
functions.description: Parses a textual identity into a SteamNetworkingIdentity. Standalone/static helper. Returns true on success.
requirements: pIdentity must be non-NULL and writable.
sizeofIdentity must be set to sizeof(*pIdentity).
pszStr must be a valid NUL-terminated string in a supported identity format.
Caller must handle false for parse failures.

functions.name: SteamAPI_SteamNetworkingSockets_v009
functions.description: Returns a pointer to the ISteamNetworkingSockets interface (version v009). Use this as the entry point to create sockets, connections, etc.
requirements: Must be called after the Steam/SDK runtime is properly initialized (per host app requirements).
Returned pointer must be checked for null before use.
Caller is responsible for lifetime rules defined by the SDK (do not delete; treat as owned by the SDK).

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateListenSocketIP
functions.signature: HSteamListenSocket SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateListenSocketIP(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, const SteamNetworkingIPAddr & localAddress, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t * pOptions);
functions.description: Creates a listen socket bound to a specific IP/port so peers can connect by IP. Optional per-socket config values can be provided.
requirements: self must be a valid ISteamNetworkingSockets pointer.
localAddress must contain a valid IP and port.
If nOptions > 0, pOptions must point to an array of at least nOptions elements; if nOptions == 0, pOptions may be null.
Returns an opaque HSteamListenSocket; check for invalid handle as failure.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConnectByIPAddress
functions.signature: HSteamNetConnection SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConnectByIPAddress(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, const SteamNetworkingIPAddr & address, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t * pOptions);
functions.description: Initiates a connection to a peer by IP address and port. Optional connection configuration values can be supplied.
requirements: self must be a valid ISteamNetworkingSockets pointer.
address must specify a valid remote IP and port.
If nOptions > 0, pOptions must reference at least nOptions items; may be null if nOptions == 0.
Returns HSteamNetConnection; verify for invalid handle on failure.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateListenSocketP2P
functions.signature: HSteamListenSocket SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateListenSocketP2P(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, int nLocalVirtualPort, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t * pOptions);
functions.description: Creates a P2P listen socket bound to a virtual port for accepting P2P connections via the relay network.
requirements: self must be valid.
nLocalVirtualPort is an application-defined non-negative integer virtual port.
If nOptions > 0, pOptions must point to at least nOptions entries; may be null if nOptions == 0.
Check returned handle for validity.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConnectP2P
functions.signature: HSteamNetConnection SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConnectP2P(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, const SteamNetworkingIdentity & identityRemote, int nRemoteVirtualPort, int nOptions, const SteamNetworkingConfigValue_t * pOptions);
functions.description: Initiates a P2P connection to a remote identity on the given virtual port using the relay network if needed.
requirements: self must be valid.
identityRemote must be a properly-initialized identity for the peer.
nRemoteVirtualPort should be a non-negative virtual port understood by the peer.
If nOptions > 0, pOptions must have at least nOptions elements; may be null if nOptions == 0.
Check returned connection handle for validity.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_AcceptConnection
functions.description: Accepts a pending incoming connection request identified by hConn.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid connection handle in a state where accepting is allowed.
Caller must check the returned EResult for success/failure.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CloseConnection
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CloseConnection(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hPeer, int nReason, const char * pszDebug, bool bEnableLinger);
functions.description: Closes an active or pending connection, optionally specifying a reason code and debug text. Linger may allow pending data to flush.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPeer must be a valid connection handle.
nReason is an application-defined or SDK-defined integer reason code.
pszDebug may be null or a UTF-8 debug string; if non-null it must be a valid pointer.
Caller should decide appropriate bEnableLinger usage based on delivery guarantees.
Return value indicates synchronous success of the close request, not necessarily delivery of any final data.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CloseListenSocket
functions.description: Closes a listen socket, rejecting future incoming connections and cleaning up resources.
requirements: self must be valid.
hSocket must be a valid listen socket handle.
Return value indicates success of closing the socket.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionUserData
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionUserData(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hPeer, int64 nUserData);
functions.description: Associates arbitrary 64-bit user data with a connection handle for application tracking.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPeer must be a valid connection handle.
Caller must ensure nUserData semantics for their app; API does not validate meaning.
Return value indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionUserData
functions.description: Retrieves the 64-bit user data previously set on a connection.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPeer must be a valid connection handle.
If no user data is set, return value semantics are per SDK (caller should handle sentinel/invalid values).

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionName
functions.signature: void SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionName(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hPeer, const char * pszName);
functions.description: Sets a human-readable name for the connection to aid in debugging and diagnostics.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPeer must be a valid connection handle.
pszName may be null or a valid pointer to a UTF-8 string; if non-null it should remain valid for the duration of the call.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionName
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionName(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hPeer, char * pszName, int nMaxLen);
functions.description: Gets the human-readable name of the connection into the supplied buffer.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPeer must be a valid connection handle.
pszName must be a writable buffer of at least nMaxLen bytes; may be null if only checking presence per SDK semantics.
nMaxLen must be non-negative.
Return indicates if a name was retrieved (and written).

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SendMessageToConnection
functions.signature: EResult SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SendMessageToConnection(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, const void * pData, uint32 cbData, int nSendFlags, int64 * pOutMessageNumber);
functions.description: Sends a data message over a connection with specified send flags; optionally returns a message number.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid, connected (or appropriate) connection handle for sending.
pData must be a valid pointer to at least cbData bytes unless cbData == 0.
cbData is the message length in bytes; may be zero for empty messages if supported.
nSendFlags must be a combination of valid SDK-defined flags.
pOutMessageNumber may be null or must point to writable storage for the result.
Caller must check returned EResult.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SendMessages
functions.signature: void SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SendMessages(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, int nMessages, SteamNetworkingMessage_t *const * pMessages, int64 * pOutMessageNumberOrResult);
functions.description: Sends an array of pre-allocated SteamNetworkingMessage_t messages in a batch. Optionally returns per-message result or message numbers.
requirements: self must be valid.
nMessages must be >= 0.
pMessages must point to an array of nMessages pointers to valid SteamNetworkingMessage_t objects (or may be null if nMessages==0).
If pOutMessageNumberOrResult is non-null, it must point to writable storage for at least nMessages int64 entries.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_FlushMessagesOnConnection
functions.description: Flushes any buffered reliable messages on the connection, attempting to send them promptly.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid connection handle.
Caller must check EResult to determine success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ReceiveMessagesOnConnection
functions.signature: int SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ReceiveMessagesOnConnection(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, SteamNetworkingMessage_t ** ppOutMessages, int nMaxMessages);
functions.description: Receives up to nMaxMessages queued incoming messages from a single connection, storing pointers to messages into ppOutMessages.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid connection handle.
ppOutMessages must point to writable storage for at least nMaxMessages message pointers; may be null if nMaxMessages==0.
nMaxMessages must be >= 0.
Return value is the number of messages returned or <0 on error per SDK semantics; caller must free/Release each returned message per API contract.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionInfo
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionInfo(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, SteamNetConnectionInfo_t * pInfo);
functions.description: Fetches general information about a connection into pInfo.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid connection handle.
pInfo must be a valid writable pointer.
Return indicates whether info was retrieved.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionRealTimeStatus
functions.signature: EResult SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetConnectionRealTimeStatus(ISteamNetworkingSockets *self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, SteamNetConnectionRealTimeStatus_t *pStats, int nLanes, SteamNetConnectionRealTimeLaneStatus_t *pLanes);
functions.description: Retrieves real-time status/metrics about a connection and optionally per-lane status.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be valid.
pStats may be null or must point to writable storage if provided.
If nLanes > 0, pLanes must point to writable storage for at least nLanes entries; if nLanes == 0, pLanes may be null.
Caller must check EResult.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetDetailedConnectionStatus
functions.signature: int SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetDetailedConnectionStatus(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, char * pszBuf, int cbBuf);
functions.description: Writes a human-readable diagnostic description of the connection into pszBuf.
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid handle.
pszBuf must be a writable buffer of size at least cbBuf bytes; may be null if cbBuf==0 per SDK behavior.
cbBuf must be >= 0.
Returns number of bytes written or required per SDK semantics.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetListenSocketAddress
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetListenSocketAddress(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamListenSocket hSocket, SteamNetworkingIPAddr * address);
functions.description: Retrieves the local bound address of a listen socket.
requirements: self must be valid.
hSocket must be a valid listen socket handle.
address must be a valid pointer to writable SteamNetworkingIPAddr.
Return indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateSocketPair
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreateSocketPair(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection * pOutConnection1, HSteamNetConnection * pOutConnection2, bool bUseNetworkLoopback, const SteamNetworkingIdentity * pIdentity1, const SteamNetworkingIdentity * pIdentity2);

requirements: self must be valid.
pOutConnection1 and pOutConnection2 must be valid pointers to writable handles.

pIdentity1 and pIdentity2 may be null or valid identities to assign to the endpoints as supported by SDK.
Return indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConfigureConnectionLanes
functions.signature: EResult SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ConfigureConnectionLanes(ISteamNetworkingSockets *self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, int nNumLanes, const int *pLanePriorities, const uint16 *pLaneWeights);
functions.description: Configures QoS lanes on a connection with priorities and weights for traffic classification.

Caller must check EResult for success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetIdentity
functions.description: Gets the local identity used by this ISteamNetworkingSockets instance.
requirements: self must be valid.
pIdentity must point to writable storage.
Return indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_InitAuthentication
functions.description: Begins or refreshes authentication of the local identity with the backend/relay network.
requirements: self must be valid.
Return value indicates availability/status of authentication; caller should handle non-ready states appropriately.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_GetAuthenticationStatus
functions.description: Queries current authentication status and optionally fills detailed status structure.
requirements: self must be valid.
pDetails may be null or must point to writable storage if provided.
Caller should interpret ESteamNetworkingAvailability to handle readiness or failures.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_CreatePollGroup
functions.description: Creates a poll group for aggregating messages from multiple connections for efficient polling.
requirements: self must be valid.
Check returned HSteamNetPollGroup for validity.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_DestroyPollGroup
functions.description: Destroys a poll group and removes all connections from it.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPollGroup must be a valid poll group handle.
Return indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionPollGroup
functions.signature: bool SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_SetConnectionPollGroup(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetConnection hConn, HSteamNetPollGroup hPollGroup);
functions.description: Assigns a connection to a poll group (or removes it by passing an invalid/zero group per SDK semantics).
requirements: self must be valid.
hConn must be a valid connection handle.
hPollGroup must be a valid poll group handle if assigning; semantics for removal follow SDK.
Return indicates success.

functions.name: SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ReceiveMessagesOnPollGroup
functions.signature: int SteamAPI_ISteamNetworkingSockets_ReceiveMessagesOnPollGroup(ISteamNetworkingSockets* self, HSteamNetPollGroup hPollGroup, SteamNetworkingMessage_t ** ppOutMessages, int nMaxMessages);
functions.description: Receives up to nMaxMessages queued messages from any connection in the poll group.
requirements: self must be valid.
hPollGroup must be valid.
ppOutMessages must point to a buffer that can store nMaxMessages message pointers; may be null if nMaxMessages==0.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingConnectionSignaling::SendSignal
functions.signature: virtual bool ISteamNetworkingConnectionSignaling::SendSignal( HSteamNetConnection hConn, const SteamNetConnectionInfo_t &info, const void *pMsg, int cbMsg ) = 0;
functions.description: Send a rendezvous/signaling message for a specific P2P connection to the remote peer. Implementations must be thread-safe; this may be invoked from any thread at any time. When initiating a connection, the peer identity may be unknown if not provided by the caller of ConnectP2PCustomSignaling. Return true if a best-effort attempt to deliver the message was made; returning false is treated as a fatal failure and the connection will be closed and Release() will be called eventually. A given signaling object is tied to one connection and will see the same hConn value each time.
requirements: Must be thread-safe; can be called from any thread at any time.
Must not hold any locks that might also be held while calling into SteamNetworkingSockets functions, to avoid deadlocks.
hConn uniquely identifies this connection; the same hConn value will be used for this signaling object across calls.
If delivery cannot be attempted, return false; this is considered fatal and will result in connection closure and a later Release().
pMsg must point to cbMsg bytes of message data intended for the remote peer; the function should not assume the peer identity is known from info if not specified in ConnectP2PCustomSignaling.
No requirement to share signaling objects between connections; signaling objects are not shared.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingConnectionSignaling::Release
functions.description: Notification that the connection no longer needs to send signaling messages. May occur some time after the connection is closed because cleanup signals might still be sent shortly after closure. If your implementation keeps no per-connection state and can handle SendSignal solely from its parameters, a single global object may be reused and Release() can be a no-op.
requirements: May be called after the connection has been closed; implementations must tolerate late calls.
Safe to implement as a no-op if using a shared/global signaling object with no per-connection state.
Should release any per-connection resources associated with this signaling object if allocated.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSignalingRecvContext::OnConnectRequest
functions.signature: virtual ISteamNetworkingConnectionSignaling * ISteamNetworkingSignalingRecvContext::OnConnectRequest( HSteamNetConnection hConn, const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identityPeer, int nLocalVirtualPort ) = 0;
functions.description: Handle an incoming custom signaling message that requests a new connection. Return a signaling object to proceed with the connection handshake, or return NULL to ignore the request (no reply sent). To actively reject, call ISteamNetworkingSockets::CloseConnection() and return NULL; the API will format a rejection and later invoke SendRejectionSignal() for transmission. If a signaling object is returned, the connection remains in the connecting state and the usual callback will be posted; you may call ISteamNetworkingSockets::AcceptConnection() before returning to immediately accept the connection. After acceptance, the connection transitions to the finding route state.
requirements: Return NULL to ignore the request; no rejection will be sent.
To actively reject, call ISteamNetworkingSockets::CloseConnection() and then return NULL; a rejection signal will be marshaled and SendRejectionSignal() will be invoked to transmit it.
If returning a signaling object but wishing to skip the normal callback flow, call ISteamNetworkingSockets::AcceptConnection() before returning to immediately accept.
Returned signaling objects are per-connection; do not share between multiple connections.

functions.name: ISteamNetworkingSignalingRecvContext::SendRejectionSignal
functions.signature: virtual void ISteamNetworkingSignalingRecvContext::SendRejectionSignal( const SteamNetworkingIdentity &identityPeer, const void *pMsg, int cbMsg ) = 0;
functions.description: Transmit an actively formatted rejection/failure signal to the specified peer. The library marshals the properly formatted rejection payload and provides it here for your transport to send. If you intend to ignore unwanted requests, this can be implemented as a no-op, but must exist because the method is pure virtual.
requirements: identityPeer identifies the remote peer to receive the rejection.
pMsg points to a rejection payload of length cbMsg bytes to be sent unchanged to the peer.
Only required if you choose to actively communicate rejection/failure; if ignoring requests, this may perform no action (though it must be implemented since the interface is pure virtual).
